claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole had fought the late prize fight of June 15, 1869.
claims.excerpt: just before the commencement of the late fight

claims.statement: Allen did not accept McCoole's challenge; he said he would fight for $5,000 a side but not inside 399 miles of St. Louis (printed as 399).
claims.excerpt: Will fight Mac for $5,000 aside, but will not meet him inside of 399 miles of St. Louis

claims.statement: Allen is said to have put up a $1,000 forfeit at the St. Louis Billiard Hall.
claims.excerpt: Allen is said to have put up, at the St. Louis Billiard a Hall, $1,000 as a forfeit
places: St. Louis Billiard Hall, St. Louis

claims.statement: Mike McCoole published a challenge to Allen to fight again within three months, 50 to 100 miles from St. Louis, with money deposited at 298 North Third Street (printed as 298; OCR is poor).
claims.excerpt: over 50 and within 100 amiles of St. Louis, and within three months’ time

fights.excerpt: just before the commencement of the late fight
fights.notes: Reference only; this article gives no detail of the bout.

notes: Mostly McCoole's challenge; Allen's reply is reported second-hand.
